_notes.owner: Who the list is for. "name" shows on the page; give "phone", "email", or both: "I'll get this" opens a text or an email to them with the gift named.
_notes.occasion: The big title at the top, such as "Maya turns 30", "Baby Ruiz", or "Our new place".
_notes.currency: The three-letter code for every price, such as USD, EUR, GBP, or JPY.
_notes.items: One entry per wish. "name" and "price" (a number) are needed. "url" is where to buy it. "image" is a picture file beside this one, such as pictures/camera.png; a picture with a clear background sits best on the stand. "note" holds size, color, or anything else. "priority" is high, normal, or low; high shows a Most wanted badge. "claimed": true folds the card under a Gotten tag; set it when someone tells the owner they're getting it.
_notes.theme: auto (light or dark from the device: ribbon by day, midnight by night), ribbon (pink tissue and raspberry), kraft (brown paper, twine, and forest green), or midnight (navy and gold).
_notes.copy: Optional: the words on the page by key, such as {"getThis": "Count me in"}. Leave a key out to keep its word; copy.js in the built site lists every key.
